record.question: If a pregnant woman is suffering from hyperthyroidism, which of the following drug is considered safe for her treatment?
record.explanation: Official final key: B — Propylthiouracil. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 10, printed Q58. Source limitation: “Pregnant woman” is insufficient to choose a single safe drug across pregnancy. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
